# Charlie Sloane & Gilbert Blythe

- [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) — presumed Rival of — [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — rivals in the good graces of Anne Shirley · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> During class at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolhouse, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Furious at the insult, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard with a message criticizing her temper, and afterward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ignores Gilbert's contrite attempt to apologize.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)_

> After being publicly humiliated and forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she calms down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is overcome with laughter when she finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping hysterically over the imaginary future scenario of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) getting married.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P81](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0081), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P96](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0096)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an extra class to prepare advanced students for Queen's entrance examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) join, which delights her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joins her classmates in the new study group, though she regrets Diana's absence and finds herself missing Gilbert's attention despite their fierce academic rivalry.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets her ongoing feud with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though the two remain intense academic rivals. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach next year, relieved students pack away their studies, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to enjoy her summer before growing up. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), expressing her relief over Matthew's health and admitting to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has matured.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized
